title: Parse numeric cells while retaining the consumed boundary
goal: Read semicolon-delimited numeric values from character or UTF-8 spans while rejecting malformed prefixes and preserving the next-field offset.

selectionNotes: Partial success does not validate a complete field; require a delimiter or the end of input.
Offsets count UTF-16 code units or UTF-8 bytes, respectively; parsing is not a full CSV grammar.

runtime.reason: Use the selected numeric runtime contracts and behavior.

language.reason: Canonical sample language mode; no experimental language feature is required.

prerequisites: SDK console project targeting net11.0 with ImplicitUsings=enable and Nullable=enable. Import System.Globalization and System.Numerics; place the supplied partial class in namespace Playbook.Samples.
constraints: Partial success does not validate a complete field; require a delimiter or the end of input.

evidence.scope: Both targets execute character/UTF-8 paths, final fields, signs/exponents, integer overflow, and rejection of empty fields, incomplete exponents, junk suffixes, comma formats, NaN/infinity and excessive exponents.
